fix: Connector was cleaned and the sensor recalibrated.
outcome: Readings matched the reference within tolerance.

issue: Cooling temperature exceeded the usual operating band
diagnosis: Coolant flow to the heat exchanger was reduced
fix: Air filter was changed and cabinet ventilation checked.
outcome: Cooling performance was restored and production resumed.

issue: Motor tripped while accelerating
diagnosis: A dull tool increased cutting load
fix: Material buildup was removed and the moving assembly serviced.
outcome: Drive operated normally under load.

issue: Cutting insert exceeded its wear limit
diagnosis: Tool offset had drifted after prolonged use
fix: New inserts were fitted and machining parameters reviewed.
outcome: Machining resumed with normal tool-life readings.

issue: Pulley tracking was uneven
diagnosis: Drive coupling was offset from the motor shaft
fix: Drive train was realigned and test vibration measurements recorded.
outcome: Drive tracking was stable during the test cycle.

issue: Machine stopped with an electrical fault indication
diagnosis: A cooling fan fuse had failed
fix: Communication connector was cleaned, reseated, and locked.
outcome: Machine restarted normally and returned to production.

issue: Lubrication pressure was lower than normal
diagnosis: Lubricant had degraded and contained contamination
fix: Old contaminated grease was removed and fresh grease applied.
outcome: Lubrication system passed the functional check.

issue: Bearing temperature was trending upward
diagnosis: Bearing showed early fatigue and dry spots
fix: Bearing was cleaned and regreased; play was checked.
outcome: Spindle performance was restored after testing.

issue: Operator noticed coolant around the side panel
diagnosis: Return hose had a small crack
fix: Loose fitting was tightened and the sealing washer replaced.
outcome: Cooling system passed the pressure check.
